notes: Eight web searches ran, none refused. Identity confirmed: Fred Wellman, retired Army officer and 'On Democracy' podcast host, won Missouri's 2nd district on 3 November 2026 (St. Louis Public Radio, https://www.stlpr.org/government-politics-issues/2026-11-03/wellman-topples-wagner-represent-missouris-2nd-congressional-district). Campaign site is https://www.wellmanformo.com/ (link from VoteVets candidate page); its home page and /policy page (about 4,000 characters, mainly affordability) contain no mention of AI or technology. His Substack post 'Old soldier, next mission' (https://fpwellman.substack.com/p/well-we-won, 7 August 2026) has no mention of AI. He was not a member of Congress in September 2026, so he could not have co-sponsored the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act; he did not sign the House letters. Ballotpedia page returned empty and fredwellman.com redirected to an unrelated WordPress address, so those were not read. A Citation Needed influence tracker page (https://influence.citationneeded.news/2026/elections/MO-H-02) reportedly shows no AI-industry PAC spending in the race (seen in search summary only, not opened). He has a large X presence; X was not searched per the brief, and his podcast episodes were not reviewed, so AI remarks there could have been missed.
